task.description:
WF-03 Step 4b validate the regression test design for the OIDC login redirect loop fix.

This is a hard gate. Validate that the spec covers the three diagnosed root causes, does not use mocks/stubs, and is suitable for execution against the real backend/browser flow. If any gap exists, fail the handoff.

Do not implement tests in this step; only validate the design.
acceptance_criteria: Spec covers all three root causes
Spec does not use mocks or stubs
Spec is executable against real backend/browser flow

result.summary: ISS-0063 test design is not yet runnable: the planned e2e test file does not exist, and the spec does not fully exercise the gateway-side redirect path or self-sufficient real backend/browser setup.

issues.description: The planned test file does not exist yet, so the regression suite is not runnable and the hard-gate requirement for implemented integration coverage is unmet.
TC-ISS-0063-02 captures the outgoing authorization URL but does not exercise the Keycloak-return path where the port/authority mismatch was diagnosed, leaving the first root cause under-validated.
The spec does not spell out self-sufficient backend/browser setup or absence-of-env failure behavior, so the real-backend requirement is only implied rather than testable from the spec text.
